description: The command hooks of the harness, a person's file under harness.self, beside the function-hook module `modules` names. PreToolUse on Edit, Write and Bash is xtask permit over the hook's stdin (harness-design.md §4.4); the hook's stdin is buffered and the candidates walked, each built binary and then cargo, stopping at the first that exits 0: permit's exit is 0 whatever it decides, so a non-zero one is a build older than the manifest or the flag it was handed, and the call is never passed on that build's silence. A built binary is a process start; cargo closes the list, rebuilding rather than trusting a stale one, about 200 ms more, and the timeout leaves room for that rebuild. Stop is xtask done --hook over the hook's stdin (§4.5): the turn is held with the unmet list as the reason, and the second Stop, stop_hook_active true, passes; it goes through cargo run, since what a turn changes is often xtask itself, and a cargo that fails is a block naming the build, never a silent pass, except on the second Stop. SessionStart on startup, resume, clear and compact points core.hooksPath at scripts/hooks when the clone has none, so pre-push is wired, lays the local file down when missing and renders it; the map plus the local facts reach the model through the function hook's prompt.context (harness-plugins/, enabled by .claude/settings.json as harness@dax-php from the repository's own marketplace; §5), and a session without the plugin has no map. Once a session, so it goes through cargo run, which rebuilds a stale binary rather than trusting it.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && in=$(cat) && { for x in target/release/xtask target/debug/xtask; do [ -x "$x" ] && printf '%s' "$in" | "$x" permit && exit 0; done; printf '%s' "$in" | cargo run -q -p xtask -- permit; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && in=$(cat) && { printf '%s' "$in" | cargo run -q -p xtask -- done --hook || case $in in *'"stop_hook_active":true'*) ;; *) echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"xtask done did not run: cargo run -q -p xtask -- done --hook failed; fix the build of xtask"}';; esac; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ -n "$(git config core.hooksPath)" ] || git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks; X='cargo run -q -p xtask --'; [ -f .claude/harness.local.md ] || $X status --session >/dev/null; computed run .claude/harness.local.md >/dev/null 2>&1; case $? in 0|1) ;; 2) echo 'harness: a marker in .claude/harness.local.md is broken; see `computed check .claude/harness.local.md`';; *) echo 'harness: computed did not run; the local facts are stale (cargo install computed)';; esac
